title: Glow In Dark Transparent – Shockproof Clear Cover
description_text: The Glow Edge transparent case offers robust shockproof protection for your iPhone, combining a clear design with a bumper that glows in the dark for added visibility. Engineered to absorb impacts, it also features raised edges to protect your camera from scratches and damage. This case preserves your phone’s sleek appearance while delivering reliable defense against everyday wear and tear.
